description: This file defines an injectable Angular service, 'ApiService', which provides generic methods for performing HTTP operations (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) against a backend API. It relies on Angular's HttpClient for HTTP requests and injects configuration through 'ConfigService'. The service abstracts common API interactions to be reused across the application.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A service class that encapsulates methods for performing HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with a backend API.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs an HTTP GET request to fetch data from the backend, accepting a URL path and optional query parameters.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs an HTTP POST request to send data to the backend, accepting a URL path and request body.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs an HTTP PUT request to update data on the backend, accepting a URL path and request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs an HTTP DELETE request to remove data from the backend, accepting a URL path.
